notes.title: Little Screamies update 1.2!
notes.content:
Greetings players of Little Screamies, thank you for playing! The team is delighted to see more and more videos being uploaded as well as more reviews. We very much appreciate this! 

As always, with the reviews and new players, some more bugs/discomforts have been found. We want you to know that we continue to read all the reviews and watch all the videos to help us as we are working hard to improve Little Screamies to the best of our abilities. 

So, with that in mind, please enjoy update 1.2 which brings in these fixes/changes!


Issues with the “Level Select” main menu option not updating without a game reset have been resolved!
Some players were reporting an Axe duplication bug in the level “Infiltration”, this has now been resolved!
There were some materials missing from some of the objects in the level “Huge” Problem, those have been fixed.
In the level “Unlikely Ally”, The door where you find Octobird now closes behind you and opens properly.
Issues with Dr. Screamcut’s vehicle animations in the level “Critical Research” have been sorted!
An issue was found while deleting saved data from the options menu. The saved data system has been re-worked and all save/load/delete issues should now be resolved! 
We have made changes to the “Camera Sensitivity” slider in the “Game” panel of the “Options” menu, and how it affects gamepad joysticks specifically. Making the joystick more sensitive, bringing things in-line with the mouse while also increasing the max sensitivity from 120 to 200.


Thank you and enjoy!


~The Nukepop Team

notes.title: Little Screamies update 1.1!
notes.content:
Greetings players of Little Screamies, first off I would like to say how much of a delight it has been for the team to see your reviews already pouring in. So, thank you! 

Amongst those reviews, there have been some bugs spotted, so, thank you for that. We have read the reviews and our team has gotten to work straight away on squashing those bugs. So, without further ado, here are the details for Little Screamies update 1.1!



 We have fixed issues that prevented players from obtaining the “Strange Contraption” and “Ooooh Buttons!...” achievements.
 We have made changes, during the loading process, to retroactively check to see if you have any Lore Pages but don’t have the achievements for them, it will then award you the achievement, Including “All the Lore”
 We have fixed an issue that stopped the level select from appearing.
 We have added an extra check at the end of the level “Huge Problem” that awards you the “Basher Beat” achievement if you get there before Basher’s chase comes to a.. Shocking… conclusion.


Thank you all again for playing.

Kind Regards

~The Nukepop Team
